stiftsbibliothek.name: Abbey Library of St. Gallen
stiftsbibliothek.slogan: A frescoed hall where books still outnumber visitors' footsteps.
stiftsbibliothek.line: Above the door a Greek inscription calls the library a "healing place for the soul"; its 2,100 manuscripts begin in the 8th century.

saentis.name: Säntis
saentis.slogan: 2,502 metres up, with six countries on a clear day.
saentis.line: The Schwägalp cable car to the summit opened on 1 July 1935, and a weather station has watched the peak since 1882.

appenzelldorf.name: Appenzell Old Town
appenzelldorf.slogan: Painted gables, cheese shops and a square that votes outdoors.
appenzelldorf.line: Each last Sunday of April about 4,000 citizens gather on Appenzell's central square to vote by raised hand at the Landsgemeinde.

kathedrale.name: St. Gallen Cathedral
kathedrale.slogan: Twin towers over the monk's cell that grew into a city.
kathedrale.line: Gallus built his hermitage here in 612; the Baroque cathedral by Peter Thumb took from 1755 to 1767.

ebenalp.name: Ebenalp and Wildkirchli
ebenalp.slogan: A cliffside chapel where hermits lived for two centuries.
ebenalp.line: Neanderthals sheltered in the Wildkirchli caves about 40,000 years ago; the last hermit there died in 1851.
